title: Remove selected header elements and Call Now button

requirements.text: Remove the anchor element and its child SVG icon identified by XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1] and /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1]/svg[1] from the Header component. These are located in the third div group of the header's first div, and both the link wrapper and the SVG inside it must be completely removed.

quotes: Ine donon ko bhi remove kar do

acceptanceCriteria: The anchor element at the specified XPath no longer exists in the rendered header
The SVG icon inside that anchor no longer exists in the rendered header
No broken layout or empty space left where the removed elements were

requirements.text: Remove the 'Call Now' button or link from the Header component (frontend/src/components/Header.tsx). This is the element labeled 'Call Now' visible in the top/header area of the page. It must be completely removed from the header markup.

quotes: call now likha hai na upar mein Hi use remove kar do

acceptanceCriteria: No 'Call Now' text, button, or link is visible in the header
The FloatingCallButton component in App.tsx (the floating fixed button) is NOT removed — only the header Call Now element is removed
Header layout remains clean and properly aligned after removal

constraints: Do not remove the FloatingCallButton component — only remove the 'Call Now' element inside the Header component
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
nonGoals: Adding Internet Identity login button to Admin Dashboard (separate pending request)
Any changes to the FloatingWhatsAppButton or FloatingCallButton floating components
